items.prompt: Solve \(x^2-7x+10=0\) by factorisation. Give both roots.
items.scheme: M1 Find two suitable numbers. M1 Factorise the quadratic. M1 Find first root. A1 Find second root.

items.prompt: Solve \(3x+2y=17\) and \(x-y=-1\). Show enough working for both variables.
items.scheme: M1 Set up elimination/substitution. M1 Reduce to one variable. M1 Find x. A1 Find y.

items.prompt: Write \(x^2-6x+16\) in completed-square form. Hence state the minimum of the expression.
items.scheme: M1 Halve the x coefficient. M1 Complete square with correction. M1 Recognise square nonnegative. A1 Correct minimum.

items.prompt: Triangle \(ABC\) has \(AB=5\text{ cm}\), \(AC=8\text{ cm}\), and \(\angle BAC=60^\circ\). Find \(BC\) exactly, using the cosine rule.
items.scheme: M1 Set up cosine rule for the included angle. M1 Substitute the lengths and exact cosine. M1 Simplify the resulting squared length. A1 Positive exact length.

items.prompt: £1000 is invested at \(5\%\) compound interest per year. Find its value after two years, assuming no fees or withdrawals.
items.scheme: M1 Determine multiplier. M1 Square for two years. M1 Apply to capital. A1 Correct value.

items.prompt: A circular sector has radius \(6\text{ cm}\) and central angle \(60^\circ\). Find its area exactly in terms of \(\pi\).
items.scheme: M1 Calculate fraction of full circle. M1 Use area of circle. M1 Simplify coefficient. A1 Exact area with units.

items.prompt: Solve \(x^2-5x+4<0\). State one interval and justify its endpoints.
items.scheme: M1 Factorise. M1 Find roots. M1 Select negative region. A1 Strict interval.

items.prompt: Two similar triangles have corresponding lengths \(3\text{ cm}\) and \(6\text{ cm}\). The smaller has area \(12\text{ cm}^2\). Find the area of the larger.
items.scheme: M1 Linear scale factor. M1 Square scale for area. M1 Multiply. A1 Correct units.

items.prompt: A bag contains \(4\) red and \(3\) blue counters. Two are chosen without replacement. Find the probability that both are red.
items.scheme: M1 First draw probability. M1 Second conditional probability. M1 Multiply probabilities. A1 Simplify.

items.prompt: For \(f(x)=2x-5\), find \(f^{-1}(x)\) and verify by simplifying \(f(f^{-1}(x))\).
items.scheme: M1 Set y=f(x). M1 Solve for x. M1 State inverse. A1 Verify composition.
